newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait crown prince well after surgery - official.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait crown prince well after surgery - official.

text.p: Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah is recovering well after colon surgery early on Saturday, an official said.
He said Sheikh Saad was recovering and "is in good condition," the official told Reuters from hospital.

Earlier on Saturday Kuwait's minister of court affairs, Sheikh Nasser Mohammad al-Ahmad al-Sabah, said in a statement carried by the official Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) that the prince had colon surgery at 5.30 a.m. (0230 GMT).
He said the prince's "condition is stable and satisfactory".
Sheikh Saad was rushed to Emiri Hospital in Kuwait City on Tuesday after fainting due to internal bleeding. He was released on Thursday, but returned to hospital a day later.
Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah visited the crown prince on Friday at hospital while several regional leaders telephoned to inquire about his health.
